_readme: Curated source list for the guest demo fixture. Hand-maintained.
Order matters: it becomes the order shown in the app (newest first).
'addedHoursAgo' must increase strictly down the list; export-demo-bookmarks.mjs enforces that.
'title' is a human-readable check only — the export refuses to run if it no longer matches the row.
Everything else (tags, summaries, metadata) is read from the database, not written here.
